title: /grc-framework loads with 4 stats cards and no console errors for a project with data
preconditions: A project with at least one active framework is selected
expectedResult: Page renders 'Active Frameworks', 'Compliant', 'Overall Compliance' and 'In Progress' stats cards with numeric values (not stuck on skeleton/'—'), and the Manage Frameworks card lists both active and available frameworks.

title: Catalog fetch (getAvailableFrameworks + getProjectFrameworkList) both resolve successfully on page load
steps: Navigate to /grc-framework and observe network calls to /compliance-frameworks/projects/:id/available-frameworks and /compliance-frameworks/projects/:id/compliance/frameworks
expectedResult: Both requests return 200 with success:true; no error/warning banner about the catalog or live scores is shown.

title: /grc-framework/:id/compliance-map loads for an active framework and renders at least one domain
preconditions: Framework is active for the current project and has at least one requirement
steps: From /grc-framework, click 'View Compliance Map' on an active framework
expectedResult: The compliance map page loads, showing the header with framework title, the 4-tile stats strip (Overall Compliance/Covered/Partial/Gap), the filter bar, and at least one expandable domain accordion section.

title: A licensed framework can be activated and appears active without error
preconditions: At least one licensed, not-yet-added framework exists in the catalog
steps: On /grc-framework, click Activate on a licensed available framework
expectedResult: Framework becomes active with no error toast, and re-fetching the page shows it listed under Active Frameworks.
